subject.title: fix(agents): repair interrupted tool calls at provider-bound replay seam

question: After rebasing onto current main, should unmatched tool-use repair remain confined to provider-bound history preparation, or should session loading normalize messages for every consumer?
rationale: The competing approaches choose different ownership boundaries with compatibility and session-context consequences, and current main has refactored the exact insertion seam since this branch was created.

options.title: Keep repair provider-bound
options.body: Rebase this approach into the current history-preparation seam, preserve the transcript-policy gate, and prove the persisted-session provider path.

options.title: Normalize during session loading
options.body: Use the broader related approach only if maintainers intentionally want every session-context consumer to receive synthesized tool results.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: First verify whether current main's extracted history preparation already covers the failure, then close or narrow redundant work.

recommendation.title: Keep repair provider-bound
recommendation.body: Rebase this approach into the current history-preparation seam, preserve the transcript-policy gate, and prove the persisted-session provider path.
